label: An approval request from Klaxon: a write action that runs only if a person approves it.

alert.name: MoneyCheckFailed
alert.summary: The money check failed 1 of its 5 invariants: payments_match_provider (56 findings).

plan.change: redeploy payments-api: PROVIDER_BREAKER on (unchanged), CHARGE_AMOUNT_UNIT dollars -> cents, REFUND_CONNECTION returned (unchanged)
plan.undo: going back to CHARGE_AMOUNT_UNIT=dollars would deploy a known-bad setting: Klaxon will not; a person can, by hand

diagnosis.hypothesis: payments-api was redeployed at 08:27:01Z with CHARGE_AMOUNT_UNIT=dollars. Since then it sends our amount in cents to fake-provider as if it were dollars, so the provider charges 100x what we recorded. The first affected payment is pmt_000230: we recorded 1291 cents and the provider charged 129100. Every payment after the deploy is overcharged this way, which produces the payments_match_provider findings. The ledger books what the provider reports, so the ledger still matches the provider and stays balanced, but customers are overcharged against our records.

evidence.shows: payments_match_provider failed with 63 findings, all starting at pmt_000230. The provider's amount is exactly 100x ours (for example 1291 against 129100 cents). The other four invariants pass. pmt_000233 is still pending on our side but charged at 100x.
payments-api is the newest deploy, at 08:27:01Z, with CHARGE_AMOUNT_UNIT=dollars. Every other service was created at 08:25:26Z.
pmt_000230, the first flagged payment, succeeded at 08:27:02.413Z, just after the deploy. We logged amount_cents=1291.

pmt_000230's trace shows payments-api inserting the payment and then POSTing to fake-provider /v1/payments with a 200 reply. The request body is not shown, so the amount actually sent is inferred from the provider's record.
pmt_000229, the last payment the check did not flag, succeeded at 08:27:00.655Z, just before the deploy. This ties the start of the overcharges to the deploy.

proposed_fix.summary: Roll payments-api back to the settings it ran before the 08:27:01Z deploy, presumably CHARGE_AMOUNT_UNIT=cents. That stops new 100x charges. Afterwards, refund the overcharged difference for pmt_000230 onward, or the full charge if refunding and re-charging is simpler, and correct the ledger. Check pmt_000233, which is pending on our side but charged at the provider, and settle its status.

diagnosis.blast_radius: Recreating payments-api pauses payment and refund intake for a few seconds. Requests in flight during the restart may fail and be retried under their idempotency keys. The rollback repairs nothing: the roughly 63 overcharged payments stay wrong until a separate repair. The previous settings are not shown in c2, so the rollback assumes the earlier value was cents.
diagnosis.rollback_plan: If the rollback makes things worse, redeploy payments-api with the settings from the 08:27:01Z deploy (PROVIDER_BREAKER=on, CHARGE_AMOUNT_UNIT=dollars, REFUND_CONNECTION=returned). Then run money_check again to confirm that new payments match the provider.
